lines.text: Today, LocoLLM has just one specialist: privacy law.
Now imagine a specialist for every place in town.
Hospitals can't send patient records to cloud AI.
But with a local health specialist, one computer is enough.
Patient data never leaves the building.
Small businesses can't pay for big cloud AI.
Free local specialists help with marketing, finance, compliance, and law.
One small model. Many free, private specialists.
This is the future of LocoLLM.
